samples.name: prop-carrot-sprout
samples.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Supplied Kenney sheets are STYLE references only. Single sprite for medieval Slavic village farming game. Two tiny thin feathery carrot seedlings centered, occupying 5x4 logical pixels. Green shoots only, no orange root. Strict 16x16 logical pixel art enlarged to square canvas: each logical pixel a large solid square. Extremely simple readable silhouette like reference crops. At most three flat green colors and three flat orange colors. Top left lighting, south-facing top-down three-quarter view. Fully transparent around subject, no soil, shadow, pot, backdrop or scenery. No antialiasing, gradients, haze, glowing edges, neon colors, tiny veins, text, panels or multiple separate sprites.
